purpose: Operationalise the already-preregistered event-side, nuisance-side, shared-optical and no-fault classes with one reproducible physical recipe chosen before any V13 observer output.
claim_boundary: This is a standardised observation-system proxy experiment, not natural pollinator-detection validation.

common_geometry.camera_mount: rigid tripod or fixed rail; no within-block movement
common_geometry.target_plane: fixed carrier plane; target centre remains fixed within a block
common_geometry.background_plane: behind target plane and mechanically isolated from the target carrier
common_geometry.canonical_reference: geometry may be checked from raw calibration pixels before observer execution, but no PolliPi/InsePi output may be used to tune apparatus

standard_event_proxy.surface: matte high-contrast dark target on a matte neutral carrier
standard_event_proxy.event_restore_definition: replace the current event proxy with an otherwise matched 100-mm high-contrast standard proxy at the same target-plane location

event_side.physical_recipe: 100-mm target at the standard target-plane location with luminance contrast attenuated by a matched neutral target/overlay; target geometry unchanged
event_side.pre_observer_physical_tolerance: absolute target-versus-carrier luminance contrast must be 0.20-0.30 of that measured for the standard event proxy under the same illumination
event_side.event_restore: replace attenuated target with the standard event proxy
event_side.observability_restore: sham nuisance-neutral handling; event attenuation remains
event_side.shared_restore: sham clear optical-carrier handling; event attenuation remains

nuisance_side.physical_recipe: mechanically isolated background foliage or flexible strips driven by a fan while the standard event proxy and camera remain fixed
nuisance_side.event_restore: replace standard event proxy with an identical standard proxy while fan remains active
nuisance_side.observability_restore: fan off; target and optical state unchanged
nuisance_side.shared_restore: sham clear optical-carrier handling while fan remains active

shared_optical.physical_recipe: semi-opaque front-of-lens strip crossing the target region and surrounding scene on a clear carrier
shared_optical.event_restore: standard event proxy handling without removing occluder
shared_optical.observability_restore: sham nuisance-neutral handling without removing occluder
shared_optical.shared_restore: replace occluding carrier with matched clear carrier

no_fault.physical_recipe: standard event proxy, nuisance source off, matched clear optical carrier
no_fault.event_restore: swap to an identical standard event proxy
no_fault.observability_restore: matched fan/control handling while nuisance remains off
no_fault.shared_restore: swap clear optical carrier for an identical clear carrier

event_side.physical_recipe: 50-mm high-contrast disk at the same fixed target-plane centre; contrast material matches the standard proxy
event_side.event_restore: replace 50-mm target with the standard 100-mm event proxy
event_side.shared_restore: sham clear optical-carrier handling; 50-mm target remains

nuisance_side.physical_recipe: opaque vane periodically traverses the illumination path without touching camera, target or background
nuisance_side.event_restore: replace standard event proxy with an identical standard proxy while shadow treatment continues
nuisance_side.observability_restore: park vane completely outside illumination path; target and optical state unchanged
nuisance_side.shared_restore: sham clear optical-carrier handling while moving-shadow treatment continues

shared_optical.physical_recipe: matte diffusion film covers the full camera aperture on a removable carrier
shared_optical.event_restore: standard event-proxy handling while diffuser remains installed
shared_optical.observability_restore: sham nuisance-neutral handling while diffuser remains installed
shared_optical.shared_restore: replace diffuser carrier with matched clear carrier

no_fault.physical_recipe: standard event proxy, nuisance source off, matched clear optical carrier on held-out day and scene
no_fault.event_restore: swap to an identical standard event proxy
no_fault.observability_restore: matched nuisance-control handling with nuisance off
no_fault.shared_restore: swap clear optical carrier for an identical clear carrier

physical_measurement_rules.target_dimensions: measure before each acquisition day with ruler/caliper
physical_measurement_rules.camera_target_distance: measure before each scene and lock mount thereafter
physical_measurement_rules.fan_air_speed: measure at the background plane before each development fan block series
physical_measurement_rules.shadow_frequency: verify from vane controller or independent timing, not observer output
physical_measurement_rules.shadow_illuminance: verify with an independent light meter before each held-out shadow block series
physical_measurement_rules.occluder_width_fraction: verify from physical carrier geometry or raw calibration image before observer execution
physical_measurement_rules.diffuser_transmittance: measure against the same steady light source without consulting observer output
physical_measurement_rules.out_of_tolerance_rule: mark protocol deviation immediately; do not tune the apparatus using PolliPi/InsePi output and do not silently replace a failed subtype

forbidden_adaptations_after_acquisition_: switch heldout moving-shadow treatment to another nuisance subtype
switch heldout diffusion treatment to glare based on observer performance
change target dimensions or contrast range based on PolliPi output
change fan speed, shadow frequency, occluder coverage or diffuser transmittance based on InsePi output
replace failed blocks after observer output without starting a new generation
